title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive - Construction Property Professional Indemnity

Overview:

As a Business Development Executive, you will proactively engage with mid-market and SME businesses across the UK, with a particular focus on clients within the construction and property professional services sector. This includes organisations such as surveyors, architects, design and planning consultancies, and engineering firms across all disciplines. You will help clients understand how you / our client can support their insurance needs, gaining valuable experience in identifying risk exposures, discussing tailored insurance solutions, and promoting end-to-end service-from initial consultation through to long-term partnership.

Your role will be central to expanding our clients client base and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional, specialist-led insurance solutions. Whether you are advising a local professional practice or supporting the placement of more complex programmes for growing and internationally active firms, your contribution will play a key role in driving continued growth.

Responsibilities:

Proactively contact prospective clients to introduce, gather relevant insurance information, and support negotiations with both clients and insurers.

Identify, research, and develop new sources of prospective clients to help expand presence and market reach.

Work closely with brokers and account handlers to support the onboarding and development of potential new clients.

Accurately maintain client and prospect records on our CRM systems, ensuring all information is recorded promptly and kept up to date in line with company standards.

Build a strong foundation of Professional Indemnity Insurance knowledge, including working towards and achieving CII insurance qualifications.

Actively participate in structured training and development programmes focused on building the core skills required for success in the role.

Contribute as part of a fast-paced, collaborative, and continually evolving environment, with significant opportunities for learning and professional growth.

Requirements:

Previous experience within the insurance market and sales.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Our clients team thrives on effective communication and the ability to work together towards common goals.

Sales and negotiation skills that will help you compete in a fast-paced market.

Strong motivation and ambition in progressing your career in insurance.

An eye for detail to ensure that all records and client interactions are meticulously managed and maintained.

title: Probate Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Bristol - Hybrid (2-3 days in office)

I'm keen to speak with experienced Sales Executives who have knowledge of Probate to join a growing team in central Bristol.

You will be the initial point of contact to a family member who has lost a loved one who needs to engage with a Lawyer to conduct their estate administration, so you will provide expert probate guidance, understanding individual needs and be able to take them through the process from initial enquiry through to quotation and contract signature.

What experience is required:
- Ideally probate experience, including technical knowledge eg; grant only estates
- Proven sales experience within probate or professional services
- Confident managing a pipeline
- A natural ability to adapt your sales approach with empathy and consultative

What is the role:
- The role is fully desk-based telephone sales using referred inbound leads
- Discuss the estate and probate service required, prepare a quote, follow up, and transfers signed clients to the legal team

What's on offer?
- Competitive full time salary
- Excellent Bonus scheme - up to 20% paid 1/4ly

If this opportunity sounds of interest, apply now with your CV or you are keen to understand the role a bit more, then please get in touch with Loraine Silvester at G2 Legal.

title: Account Manager
description:
We're working with a specialist data and technology agency to find an Account Manager who enjoys both client relationships and hands-on delivery. This is not a traditional account role focused mainly on relationship management and upselling. You'll own day-to-day client relationships while also managing projects, coordinating technical and analytical teams, tracking budgets and keeping delivery on track.

What you'll be doing
As an Account Manager, you'll manage multiple client relationships and become a key point of contact across a varied portfolio. Projects can include CRM and platform work, data and insight projects, technology implementations, ongoing retainers and smaller consultancy projects.

You'll turn client requirements into clear briefs, coordinate internal teams and manage delivery from kick-off through to completion. You'll maintain project plans, timelines, risks and dependencies, oversee scope and change control, and coordinate specialist teams to make sure work is delivered on time and within agreed parameters.

Commercial management is also an important part of the role. You'll track budgets, resource and forecasting, monitor profitability and identify risks early. Project values can range from around £5k to £200k, with larger projects supported by the Pod Lead. You'll also identify opportunities and contribute to account growth, without being the primary commercial owner.

You'll work across a range of CRM, data and marketing technology platforms, supporting clients with complex data-led projects and implementations.

What experience you'll need to apply
- Experience in Account Management, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Service Delivery or a similar client-facing role.
- Experience managing projects across CRM, data, technology, SaaS, software or digital environments.
- Strong hands-on project delivery experience, including timelines, scope, risks, dependencies and change control.
- Experience managing budgets, resource allocation, forecasting or project profitability.
- Comfortable coordinating multiple clients, projects and specialist teams at the same time.
- Experience working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience with CRM, data or marketing technology platforms would be useful.
- Commercial awareness and experience identifying opportunities or contributing to account growth.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information for different audiences.

What you'll get in return for your experience
You'll receive a competitive salary and benefits package including enhanced pension contributions, life assurance, wellness rewards, private healthcare and critical illness cover. You'll also have access to flexible hybrid working (1/2 days a week in the office) and professional development opportunities, including product and service accreditations. You'll join an organisation that places a strong emphasis on responsible business, inclusion, transparency and employee wellbeing.

What's next?
If the Account Manager opportunity sounds like a good match for your experience, apply via the button below or contact the recruitment consultant for a confidential conversation. The process starts with an initial conversation, followed by a second-stage interview and task. Reasonable adjustments can be provided for qualified candidates with disabilities where required.

title: Account Manager
description:
Account Manager - Relish

Are you an organised and commercially minded Account Manager with experience delivering experiential or out-of-home campaigns?

Relish is looking for a confident and proactive Account Manager to join its growing team. In this client-facing role, you'll take ownership of campaigns from initial enquiry through to final delivery, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to a high standard.

You'll build strong relationships with clients, retailers, and suppliers while balancing project management, commercial responsibility, and day-to-day account growth.

Why apply?

Join a collaborative and ambitious business where you'll have genuine ownership of client relationships and campaigns. You'll work across a diverse range of experiential projects, develop your commercial expertise, and play a key role in delivering memorable activity for leading brands and retail partners.

If you're a proactive Account Manager with a passion for client service and experiential marketing, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As Account Manager, you will take responsibility for the day-to-day management of allocated client accounts and experiential campaigns. You will work closely with the sales team, clients and external suppliers to turn ideas and enquiries into successful, measurable activations.

You will also manage a portfolio of retailer relationships, monitor revenue and forecasts, communicate pipeline updates and ensure that agreed KPIs and service levels are achieved.

Key responsibilities
- Manage experiential, sampling and out-of-home campaigns from briefing through to completion.
- Support the sales team in converting campaign opportunities and delivering against client expectations.
- Build and maintain trusted relationships with allocated clients, retailers and suppliers.
- Independently manage inbound enquiries, insert advertisers, bookings and allocated projects.
- Coordinate with experiential, print and packaging suppliers, negotiating effectively to achieve high-quality and commercially competitive outcomes.
- Create and manage detailed project plans and critical pathways, identifying potential delays, risks and contingency requirements.
- Monitor campaign budgets, commercials and profitability.
- Maintain accurate revenue forecasts, pipelines and account updates.
- Ensure client and supplier KPIs, service levels and deadlines are consistently achieved.
- Identify suitable brands for campaigns and undertake outreach to both new and existing contacts.
- Spot opportunities to increase revenue and client spend across allocated accounts.
- Prepare clear, persuasive presentations, proposals and strategic narratives for client and supplier meetings.
- Attend and occasionally present or pitch during client and supplier meetings.
- Manage essential campaign administration, including supplier set-up, purchase orders, billing, invoicing and payment terms.
- Travel independently to client meetings and campaign locations when required.
- Represent the organisation professionally and in line with its core values.

Benefits
- 23 days' annual leave
- Company Pension
- Long service rewards: both financial and leave-based.
- Health cash plan.
- Life assurance scheme.
- Critical Illness cover
- Access to our prestige benefits and rewards portal.
- Career development opportunities.
- Access to a well-established Employee Assistance Programme provider.
- And other excellent benefits you'd expect from a market leader.

Requirements

About you

You will be confident, enthusiastic and motivated, with the ability to build credibility quickly with clients and suppliers. You will enjoy working at pace, balancing commercial conversations with detailed project administration.

To be successful, you will ideally have:
- Experience delivering experiential marketing or out-of-home activations.
- An interest in developing a career in marketing, account management or campaign delivery.
- Strong project management and organisational skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and changing priorities.
- Strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
- A confident communication style across telephone, email, face-to-face meetings and presentations.
- Good commercial awareness and strong negotiation skills.
- Confidence working with numbers, budgets and Microsoft Excel.
- A practical, solutions-focused approach to problem-solving.
- The ability to work collaboratively while also taking independent ownership of projects.
- A flexible and positive approach to change.
- Availability to work outside standard hours occasionally when campaigns or client meetings require it.

Desirable experience
- Previous experience working within a marketing agency.
- Knowledge of the FMCG, health, beauty or fashion sectors.
- Experience identifying and developing commercial opportunities.
- An interest in social media.
- A full, clean driving licence.

title: Corporate Account Handler / Client Advisor
description:
Corporate Account Handler / Client Advisor

Bristol Salary £30,000 - £40,000

Are you an experienced Insurance Account Handler or Client Adviser looking for your next opportunity within the commercial insurance market?

We are working with an established insurance business that is looking to appoint a Corporate Account Handler to join its Bristol team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong understanding of commercial insurance who enjoys building relationships, delivering excellent client service and working closely with experienced Client Executives.

In this role, you will take responsibility for the day-to-day servicing of a portfolio of commercial insurance clients, working closely with Client Executives and wider internal teams to ensure clients receive a high-quality, responsive service.

The Role

You will be responsible for:

-Managing the day-to-day servicing of commercial insurance accounts.

-Working closely with Client Executives to support the management and development of client relationships.

-Applying your commercial insurance knowledge to client queries and account requirements.

-Working with standard policy wordings, extensions and limitations.

-Liaising with insurers and assisting with negotiations where required.

-Supporting the full end-to-end broking process, including new business, renewals and ongoing client servicing.

-Maintaining accurate client records and using internal systems effectively, including invoicing and data management.

-Identifying opportunities to meet wider client needs and referring these to relevant internal colleagues.

-Building strong working relationships with colleagues and contributing positively as part of a collaborative team.

-Maintaining your professional knowledge and continuing professional development.

-Working in line with FCA requirements, business processes and regulatory standards.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:

-Previous experience within commercial insurance, ideally in an Account Handler, Client Adviser or similar position.

-Strong technical knowledge of the commercial insurance market.

-A good understanding of insurance broking processes and regulatory requirements.

-Excellent communication, organisation and administration skills.

-The ability to manage your own workload, prioritise effectively and meet deadlines.

-Confidence dealing with clients, insurers and internal stakeholders.

-A proactive and collaborative approach to delivering positive client outcomes.

-Experience using insurance systems; knowledge of Acturis would be advantageous.

-Cert CII qualification or a willingness to work towards this.

Based in Bristol, this is an opportunity to join a professional commercial insurance environment where you can continue developing your technical knowledge and career while working alongside an experienced team.
